$comment: Coldline Task 4.3 supplied output schema. Supplied and settled: src/worker/guardrail.py enforces it and the worker stores only what passes it. Strict on purpose: every property is required, no other property is accepted, the two classifications are closed lists, and every string is bounded. The emulator's default answer satisfies it; the supplied bad answers do not. Do not loosen it.
title: Coldline exception summary
description: The one document the model provider may answer an exception-resolution request with. The guardrail validates the provider's raw answer against this schema before the worker stores anything from it.

summary.description: The dispatcher-facing summary of the excursion. Free text within the length bound; it is advice for a person to judge, never an instruction the system acts on.

handling_class.description: Which handling situation the answer classifies the reading as. A closed list: a value outside it is rejected, not mapped.

next_step.description: The one next step the answer recommends to the dispatcher. A closed list: a value outside it is rejected, not mapped. Every value on the list keeps a person in the decision.

procedure_id.description: The identifier of the procedure the request carried, or null when retrieval found none. The schema checks the identifier's format and length; it does not verify that the identifier matches the retrieved procedure. The pattern ends with an absolute-end lookahead rather than `$`, because a `$` anchor also matches before a trailing newline.

response_id.description: The provider's per-answer response identifier: exactly sixteen lowercase hexadecimal characters, bounded by length as well as by pattern so a trailing newline is rejected.
